easyPrerequisites:
"Black" chosen with Painter's Servant.
You have a way to draw a card.
description:
Draw a card.
Niv-Mizzet triggers, dealing 1 damage to target opponent.
The Master of Lake-town triggers, causing that player to mill a card.
Since the card will be black due to Painter's Servant, Compost triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.
Draw a card.
Niv-Mizzet triggers, dealing 1 damage to target opponent.
The Master of Lake-town triggers, causing that player to mill a card.
Since the card is black due to Painter's Servant, Compost triggers, allowing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2 until your library is empty or you decline to draw a card.
